title: Uncaught Abort exception
detail: The outermost try/except only catches EOFError and KeyboardInterrupt. The removed except Abort block means an Abort raised during command execution will propagate out of Command.main, causing an unhandled traceback instead of the intended exit behavior.

title: EPIPE error not handled
detail: The original code handled EPIPE by pacifying stdout/stderr and exiting with code 1. The new code only raises for non‑EPIPE errors, leaving EPIPE unhandled and causing an unhandled OSError to propagate.

title: Incorrect lock status check
detail: DeferredLock exposes a `locked()` method, not a `locked` attribute. The condition always evaluates to True, causing the lock to be acquired twice and potentially deadlocking.
